Global (All).summary: Food prices have increased globally due to droughts in key-producing countries and ongoing war in Ukraine, raising concerns about food security.

Japan.summary: Japan's consumer sentiment has hit a 52-year low, with households citing economic concerns as the primary reason. This development has led to worries about the economic growth of the country and potential impact on the overall economy.
